title: Derived represented functor comparison normalized on resolution cocycles
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category with morphisms in universe $v$, with injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and $\operatorname{HasExt}^{v}$. Let $A\in\mathcal A$, let $H:\mathcal A\to\mathrm{Ab}^{v}$ be additive, and let $e:\operatorname{Hom}(A,-)\simeq H$ be an additive natural isomorphism. There exist natural isomorphisms $x_n:R^nH\simeq\operatorname{Ext}^n(A,-)$ for every $n\ge0$, normalized as follows. For every $Y$, every injective resolution $I$ of $Y$, every cocycle $s:A\to I^p$, and every $c\in Z^p(H(I))$ whose image under the cycle inclusion is $e_{I^p}(s)$, one has $\rho_I(x_p(Y)^{-1}(I.\mathrm{extMk}(s)))=\pi(c)$. Here $\rho_I$ is the canonical right-derived resolution comparison [lem-sp-derived-well-defined] and $\pi:Z^p(H(I))\to H^p(H(I))$ is the homology projection. There is no second category, pushforward, or augmented comparison in this statement.

proof.text: Construct a resolution-local isomorphism explicitly: extAddEquivCohomologyClass, HomComplex.leftHomologyData.homologyIso inverse, the fromSingleEquiv complex isomorphism, e.mapHomologicalComplex, mapExtendIso and extendHomologyIso. Differential compatibility follows from δ_fromSingleMk. On extMk(s), extEquivCohomologyClass_extMk, cyclesIso_inv_comp_iCycles, cyclesMap_i and extendCyclesIso_hom_iCycles identify the transported cycle with c by monicity; π_comp_homologyIso_inv, homologyπ_naturality and homologyπ_extendHomologyIso_hom then give its class. This construction also covers degree zero without a separate vanishing assumption.

Prove naturality of any two normalized resolution-local isomorphisms. By extMk_surjective it suffices to treat a represented cocycle s. Construct its H-cycle by cyclesMk and naturality of e. cyclesMap_i and naturality of e identify its image under a comparison map with the cycle represented by s composed with that map. extMk_comp_mk₀ and homologyπ_naturality give equality of the two maps on this representative, and hence on all Ext classes.

Compose each resolution-local isomorphism with the inverse of isoRightDerivedObj. The preceding naturality and isoRightDerivedObj_inv_naturality imply naturality on rightDerived. Use injectiveResolution for each object and NatIso.ofComponents to obtain the natural isomorphisms x. For any other resolution, apply the same naturality to desc of the identity; both functors map the identity to the identity, so their components coincide. Cancel the resolution comparison and apply the local cocycle normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_ext_rightDerived_cocycle_comparison
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [HasExt.{v} C]
    [HasInjectiveResolutions C] (A : C) (H : C ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{v}) [H.Additive]
    (e : preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (op A) ≅ H) :
    ∃ x : ∀ n : ℕ, H.rightDerived n ≅ (Abelian.extFunctor n).obj (op A),
      ∀ (Y : C) (I : InjectiveResolution Y) (p : ℕ)
        (s : A ⟶ I.cocomplex.X p) (hs : s ≫ I.cocomplex.d p (p + 1) = 0)
        (c : ((H.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex).cycles p)
        (hc : ((H.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex).iCycles p c =
          e.hom.app (I.cocomplex.X p) s),
        (I.isoRightDerivedObj H p).hom ((x p).inv.app Y (I.extMk s (p + 1) rfl hs)) =
          ((H.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex).homologyπ p c
